name: Geylang Bahru West
summary: West of Geylang Bahru toward Kallang Bahru industrial edges — DTL-adjacent practical living with mixed estate texture and ActiveSG catchment.
body: Geylang Bahru West is the shortlist when DTL adjacency and practical rents matter more than polished condo brochure parks. The pocket sits west of Geylang Bahru toward Kallang Bahru edges; housing mixes HDB, mid-age walk-ups, and selective condo stock. Expats land here for car-light hops to Bugis / Chinatown and ActiveSG catchment without Orchard premiums. Watch-outs: industrial-edge truck noise, loading-bay rules that differ estate-to-estate, and weekend pickleball release competition. Compare with Boon Keng North for denser NEL living, Woodleigh Fringe for newer quieter stock, and Kallang Bend when stadium energy is intentional.
